2.  24-55845  Recommendation to receive and file the Homeless Count Presentation and
  Updates by Dalton Dorr and Steven Perle from the Health Department.

  A motion was made by Member Martins, seconded by Voting Member Lock, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  14 Washington, Diles III, Brezenoff, Richert, Martins, Amick,
  Chotiswatdi, Bambrick, Boyce, McCullom, Shuford, Wee, Lewis, Lock
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 3 Tan, Topolewski, McFadzen

  • City Staff Steven Perle gave a presentation on the upcoming Point-In-Time
  (PIT) Count scheduled for January 23, 2025. This event will involve a
  thorough count and survey of all individuals experiencing homelessness in
  Long Beach, including both those who are sheltered and unsheltered.
  • The PIT Count is a crucial effort to gather data on homelessness, helping to
  guide decisions on resource allocation and support services.
  • Anyone interested in supporting or participating can find all the details on the
  Homeless Services website. Additionally, there is an opportunity to donate
  hygiene kits for those who are unable to volunteer their time.
  • Members of the board had questions regarding the presentation, staff
  responded.

3.  24-55846  Recommendation to receive and file the Homeless Services Bureau Staff and
  Operations Update presentation by Paul Duncan from the Health Department.

  A motion was made by Member Amick, seconded by Member Richert, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  14 Washington, Diles III, Brezenoff, Richert, Martins, Amick,
  Chotiswatdi, Bambrick, Boyce, McCullom, Shuford, Wee, Lewis, Lock
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 3 Tan, Topolewski, McFadzen

  • Paul Duncan, Homeless Services Bureau Manager, provided updates on
  staffing.
  • The Office of Homeless Strategies and Partnerships hosted community
  engagement sessions regarding Proposition 1 proposals. The proposal for
  the MSC and 702 Anaheim will be presented to the City Council on 12/10.

  Page 2 of 4
   LONG BEACH CONTINUUM OF CARE MINUTES
  TUESDAY, DECEMBER 10, 2024
  1500 HUGHES WAY STE. C-300 LONG BEACH, CA 90810
  HOUSING AUTHORITY, 3:00 PM

  • A community mural will begin to be painted at the MSC in December.
  • Staff attended the Built for Zero conference, hosted by Community Solutions,
  where they connected with other communities to discuss data-driven
  decision-making and strategies to reduce target populations in efforts to
  reach zero homelessness.
  • Staff is in the final stages of working with the City Auditor’s Office on the
  audit process.
  • City staff and board members had discussions regarding the operating dates
  for the winter shelter.

4.  24-55847  Recommendation to receive and file the HSAC Representative Report.

  • Member Kimberly Lewis introduced herself and gave a brief overview of the
  SOP updates that will be voted on at the next meeting. She also mentioned
  that utility bill inserts have been distributed, allowing residents to contribute
  to the mayor’s fund.
  • Bureau Manager Paul Duncan provided an update on the ongoing
  discussions within HSAC regarding grant opportunities and the response
  needs for the unsheltered population. He also highlighted the continued
  conversation around safe sleep options and restroom access.

  A motion was made by Member Washington, seconded by Member Martins, to
  approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  14 Washington, Diles III, Brezenoff, Richert, Martins, Amick,
  Chotiswatdi, Bambrick, Boyce, McCullom, Shuford, Wee, Lewis, Lock
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 3 Tan, Topolewski, McFadzen

PUBLIC COMMENT

No public comment.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

  • Kimberly Lewis, a board member, announced that her nonprofit is offering free commercials to
  service providers.
  • Staff will be sending an email about the CoC board applications for the open seats.
  • The Long Beach Homeless Coalition will hold its annual ceremony on December 21st to honor
  those who have passed away this year due to homelessness.
